meta.title: Increase Event Time: Increase Event Time by 15 minutes updates the end time successfully

plan.title: Increase Closed RFQ Event Time by 15 Minutes

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A's bid.
Open the RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses tab as specified by the case.
Open Extend Submission Time, select 15 minutes, confirm, and verify the window saves with the new end time exactly 15 minutes after the prior end time and closes.
